description: Lampongstraat 2-20 and Borneostraat 7-27 (BAG 1914): 6-7 m grey-brown brick fronts of a 3.6 m ground storey and three 3.0 m upper storeys under a white bracketed gutter at 13.0 m; four axes per front, a pair of wide cream-framed windows (red sashes) and a pair of narrow ones, the narrow pair on the door side so fronts mirror about the party wall; a white double door and two ground windows; one white timber flat dormer or a shared pointed brick gable on a tiled roof

match.note: BAG 1914, 3DBAG eaves 12.8 m, ridge 15.6-15.8 m on 16 of 17 Lampongstraat 2-20 and Borneostraat 7-27 pands; the 11-12 m double pands (Lampongstraat 12-18, Borneostraat 7-11) hold two fronts and are placed by their module count, not drawn here as one front; Lampong's 2025 panorama has a blue white-balance error (the white downpipe reads #d1e6fb): corrected against it the brick is a warm grey of about #807c6d (palette warm-grey; the 2023 Borneostraat strip reads #6d5d53, grey-brown)

flat-dormer.note: Lampongstraat 10 and 8: a white timber box dormer about 1.25 m wide and 1.6 m tall (white cheeks, a hoist beam), 13.3-15.1 m, on the red tile roof behind a white bracketed gutter at 13.0 m

shared-gable.note: Borneostraat 15|17 and 19|21 (strip 2023-01-02, gridded on 17|19): ONE pointed brick gable about 4.7 m wide centred on the party wall of the pair, apex about 2.85 m over the gutter (15.7 m), a pair of attic windows in each half (pair module: this variant is the left half, the right half is its mirror)

door-right.note: a white double door 1.7 m wide at 3.8-5.5 m from the left edge, against the party wall; two windows to its left

rhythm.bays: 4 axes: two wide windows, two narrow windows on the door side; ground: two windows + double door
rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: white double door against the party wall
rhythm.roofline: white bracketed gutter, one white flat dormer per front on a red tile roof

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2025-09-26, 40 px/m, gridded: pands 10 and 8 (6.0 m): wide windows 1.1 m at 1.0 and 2.55 m from the left edge, narrow 0.6 m at 4.4 and 5.4 m; window heads 3.3, 6.4, 9.4, 12.3 m (3.0 m pitch), 2.0 m tall (storey 3 1.9 m); double door 3.8-5.5 m; gutter 13.0 m; dormer 13.3-15.1 m. Borneostraat 13-25 (2023-01-02) reads the same rhythm

schemaLimits: the paired double-leaf door with one shared white frame (drawn as a single leaf)
the low iron rail under the wide windows
the bracket row under the gutter
Djambistraat 40's group of three narrow lights on the door side (the type draws two)
